check_script_error_logged.py: CORRECT AS WARN. PostToolUse auto-logger for the friction ladder. It writes the friction row and prints the resulting occurrence count; the ladder signal it carries is already durable in memory/friction-log.md, which is the surface actually consulted. This is the ONE lane in the repo whose loop closes without a human, and it closes through the file, not through stderr. 2026-08-25.
log_tool_failure.py: CORRECT AS WARN. PostToolUseFailure logger, not a gate: its real output is a row appended to memory/friction-log.md, and stderr is incidental progress noise. Nothing downstream reads its stderr, and it has no verdict to deliver -- a failure it records has already happened. Exit 0 is right; exit 2 would block the turn after every tool error. 2026-08-25.
